title: Normal integral geometry of all field extensions of smooth connected fibres
statement: Let $v:V\to B$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Suppose that every fibre $V_t=V\times_B\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$, for $t\in B$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-affine-spectrum], is geometrically connected [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], with connectedness including nonemptiness [def-weil-connected-scheme]. For every $t\in B$ and every field extension $K/\kappa(t)$ [def-pc-field-extension], put $C=V_t\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)}\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-pc-base-change]. Then $C$ is an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] and every local ring $\mathcal O_{C,x}$ is an integral domain integrally closed in its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. No quasi-compactness, separatedness, Noetherian or normality assumption on $B$ or $V$ is imposed.

proof.text: Fix $t\in B$ and $K/\kappa(t)$. Apply clause (2) of [lem-pc-proper-base-change] first to $v$ along $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)\to B$, and then to $V_t\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$ along $\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$. Thus $c:C\to S=\operatorname{Spec}K$ is smooth. These are exactly the two defining fibre products [def-pc-base-change]. In Lean both changes are discharged by the Mathlib Smooth pullback instances; no properness clause or Proper-module declaration is needed.

source.place: Tag 01VB, lemma-base-change-smooth; twice, to the residue fibre and its field extension

proof.text: For every field extension $L/K$, the universal property of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] identifies $C\times_K L$ with $V_t\times_{\kappa(t)}L$: both classify compatible maps to $V_t$ and $\operatorname{Spec}L$. The latter is connected by geometric connectedness of $V_t$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Hence $c$ has geometrically connected fibres, since $S$ has one point with residue field $K$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Taking $L=K$ shows $C$ is nonempty [def-weil-connected-scheme]. In Lean the GeometricallyConnected pullback instance packages this pasting argument, and GeometricallyConnected.connectedSpace_of_subsingleton gives ConnectedSpace C.

source.place: Tag 057J, lemma-normal-morphism-irreducible, geometric-fibre argument; field-extension quantifiers written out

proof.text: The scheme $S=\operatorname{Spec}K$ is integral with integrally closed local rings: it is a one-point scheme whose only nonempty open has ring $K$, and whose stalk is $K$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-pc-integral-scheme]. Indeed every nonzero element of $K$ is invertible, so $K$ is a domain and its own fraction field. Take the actual cartesian generic fibre $C_\eta=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}K(S)$, which exists by [def-pc-fibre-product]. Apply [lem-sbc-smooth-connected-generic-geometry-core] to $c$, with precisely these base hypotheses and the nonemptiness proved above. Its total-space conclusions say $C$ is integral and all its local rings are integrally closed. For $x\in C$, an affine neighbourhood has a domain as coordinate ring by [def-pc-integral-scheme]; its localization at the prime of $x$ is $\mathcal O_{C,x}$, hence is a domain. Together these give exactly the required normal-domain conclusion. The choices of $t$ and $K$ were arbitrary. In Lean normality of the field-spectrum stalks is Scheme.isIntegrallyClosed_stalk_Spec K; the generic fibre is pullback a c with a = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S), so IsPullback.of_hasPullback a c supplies the square. The IsIntegral stalk instance supplies IsDomain.

lean.statement: theorem smooth_connected_fibre_normal_integrality {V B : Scheme.{u}} (v : V ⟶ B) [Smooth v] (hconn : ∀ t : B, GeometricallyConnected (v.fiberToSpecResidueField t)) (t : B) (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra (B.residueField t) K] : IsIntegral (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (v.fiberToSpecResidueField t) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField t) K)))) ∧ ∀ x : pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (v.fiberToSpecResidueField t) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField t) K))), IsDomain ((pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (v.fiberToSpecResidueField t) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField t) K)))).presheaf.stalk x) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed ((pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (v.fiberToSpecResidueField t) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField t) K)))).presheaf.stalk x)
